title: The Lavender Gamer Girl Christmas Gift Setup
description: A lavender gamer girl Christmas gift setup: light-up cat ear headphones, a retro typewriter keyboard and mouse, a purple cat desk mat, a pink paw mug warmer, a pink mushroom lamp and a headphone stand.
intro: I put the cat ear headphones on to "test them" and then sat there for ten full minutes watching the ears change colour like a toddler. That's the review. This whole desk is lavender, pink and a little ridiculous in the best way: a typewriter keyboard that clicks like an old movie, a mushroom lamp that glows like a nightlight for grown women, and a paw-shaped mug warmer that kept my cocoa hot through an entire gaming session.

sections.heading: Ears that light up
paragraphs: Bluetooth cat ear headphones in gradient purple, with RGB lights in the ears and a built-in mic, rest on a pink aluminium headphone stand between sessions.

sections.heading: The desk itself
paragraphs: The Hamile retro typewriter keyboard and mouse set in purple comes with a matching wrist rest. It sits on a 31.5 by 11.8 inch purple floral cat desk mat.

sections.heading: Warm and glowy
paragraphs: The Gaiatop cat paw mug warmer in pink keeps a drink hot, and the ONEWISH pink glass mushroom lamp, 7.1 inches tall, adds the glow.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The rooms, food, furniture and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
